本榜收录自 2020 年以来 IPFcn B 级（区域赛）及以上级别赛事的成绩。APF（亚洲力量举联合会）和 IPF（国际力量举联合会）国际赛事的单场成绩表涵盖各代表队。代表中国参赛的运动员成绩计入总榜。个别涉及反兴奋剂争议的运动员未纳入统计。

These rankings cover IPFcn competitions at Grade B (regional) or above from 2020 onward. Individual meet results for Asian Powerlifting Federation (APF) and International Powerlifting Federation (IPF) events include all teams. Athletes representing China are included in the overall IPFcn rankings. A small number of athletes involved in anti-doping disputes are excluded.
